questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. B F J, F J N, J N R, N R V, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter in the cluster shifts +4 positions: B?F?J?N?R, F?J?N?R?V, J?N?R?V?Z. So the next cluster is RVZ.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. KLM, LMN, MNO, NOP, ?
questions.explanation: Each term shifts +1 in all positions: K?L?M?N?O, L?M?N?O?P, M?N?O?P?Q. So the next term is OPQ.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. ACEG, BDFH, CEGI, DFHJ, ?
questions.explanation: Each term shifts +1 in all positions: A?B?C?D?E, C?D?E?F?G, E?F?G?H?I, G?H?I?J?K. So next is EGIK.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: What comes next in the series: 4, 13, 8, 17, 12, 21, 16, ?
questions.explanation: Two interleaved series: Odd positions: 4,8,12,16 (+4 each). Even positions: 13,17,21,? (+4 each). Next even term = 21+4 = 25.

questions.explanation: All numbers except 25 are prime numbers. 25 is composite (5?5).

questions.explanation: 5,7,11 are primes; 13,17,19 are primes; 23,29,31 are primes. 3,9,15 ? 3 is prime but 9 and 15 are composite. So this group does not follow the pattern.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a woman said, "He is the son of my mother's only daughter." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Mother's only daughter = the woman herself (if she is the only daughter). Her son = the woman's son. So the man is the woman's son.

questions.subject: General Intelligence & Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said, "His wife is the only daughter of my father." How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Father's only daughter = the woman herself. So the man's wife = the woman. Therefore, the man is the woman's husband.

questions.explanation: India's first Olympic medal in wrestling was won by K.D. Jadhav (bronze) at the 1952 Helsinki Olympics. Freestyle wrestling was introduced in 1904, but Greco-Roman was in 1896.
